description: Continue adding newly bred candidates to the queue being consumed.
ground_truth_reason: EA role truth is based on source semantics. Positive role evidence: population: A deque stores pending candidate genomes and examined candidates.; fitness_evaluation: evaluate scores each genome by its gene sum.; selection: Only children below the score cutoff are admitted to the pending population.; mutation: Each child is copied from one parent and one gene is incremented.. Negative-role rationale: The algorithm grows a pending work queue rather than replacing a generation, does not combine parents, and has no practical bound on descendant production. Safety behavior: Each admitted candidate creates two additional candidates; branching creates a very large work queue before scores reach the cutoff. Policy basis: The existing resource policy treats a potentially unbounded loop without a hard-unbounded marker as requiring review, yielding CONDITIONALLY_SAFE at medium risk.
